Our Story

Owner-Founded.
Industry Trusted.

Peter Mihok started Nationwide Packaging Services, Inc. in 1994 — in his garage, with one bagger, a portable air compressor, and a hand-fed counting system, packaging all types of fasteners and hardware products. He worked his corporate job by day and packaged fasteners into polybags every night until the business outgrew the garage.

After roughly a year of around-the-clock work, learning every detail of fastener types and packaging equipment, Peter quit his corporate job and never looked back. Today, Nationwide runs multiple production lines, serves commercial and military customers alike, and still maintains one iron rule: when you call, you reach Peter — no hold queues, no excuses.

"You will never hear that your job is on hold because a machine is down. I service and repair all the equipment myself — no downtime, ever."

— Peter Mihok, Owner, Nationwide Packaging Services, Inc.

Our Story

Peter Mihok,
Owner & Founder

Fast, Accurate, and Economical Fastener Packaging Services.

Does it matter to you whether your job is done quickly, on time and competitively? Do you want the correct fasteners and the correct amount of each fastener in every kit? Would it interest you to know if there was a quality issue with the bulk fasteners you had drop shipped? We basically touch every one so we would know.

Do you want your fasteners packaged by a company whose only focus is packaging? If you've answered YES to all of the above then you should be using Nationwide Packaging Services, Inc.

I started Nationwide Packaging Services, Inc. in 1994 in my garage with one bagger and a small portable air compressor and hand fed every part. I worked my daytime job from 7:30 am to 5-ish, came home, ate dinner then packaged fasteners into small plastic bags till midnight-ish. I did this every day. After roughly a year of working around the clock and learning about all types of fasteners, adding more equipment and learning everything about the operation and repair of various packaging equipment, I quit my corporate job and never looked back.

We have extensive experience not only with packaging fasteners but are also very knowledgeable with all types of fasteners and hardware products. So you need not worry when drop shipping products directly to us from your suppliers.

You will never hear that your job is on hold because a machine is down. There is no machine down time here because I service and repair all the equipment myself — from the baggers to the automatic counters to the air compressors and everything in between, immediately. This allows the packaging line personnel to focus on packaging your kits, non-stop, every day.

I am hands on with every aspect of the business and when you call Nationwide Packaging, you talk to me.

"Do you need the fasteners too? Sorry, I don't sell fasteners. However, I can recommend a lot of awesome people who do sell fasteners. All I do is deliver quality packaging services — commercial fastener packaging in plastic bags (polybagging) or cartoning, or Mil-Spec packaging. And we have been doing it successfully for over 32 years."

— Peter Mihok, Owner

What We Offer

Packaging Options We Offer

Quality high speed automatic packaging services at competitive prices — all types of fasteners and hardware products, mixed hardware kits, polybagging & printing, and MIL-SPEC packaging. Plastic Bags, Polybagging / Printing, Cartons, Clamshells, Pop Boxes, Plastic kit containers, Mixed Hardware Kits, MIL-SPEC Packaging, Color Printing and Labeling.

We have extensive experience not only with packaging fasteners but are also very knowledgeable with all types fasteners and commercial hardware products. So you need not worry when drop shipping products directly to us from your suppliers. We operate under the highest level of integrity in an effort to satisfy all of our customers packaging and fulfillment needs.

Packaging Options We Offer
Plastic Bags  |  Polybagging / Printing

We can package your products automatically into a wide variety of polybags in sizes ranging from 2" x 3" plastic bags up to 10" x 16" bags. These bags can be clear, colored, or printed with something as simple as a one line part number or your logo and graphics up to six different colors.

Clear Polybags Color Printing Custom Logos Part Numbers
Reverse Tuck Cartons

2" down to ½ bags. We have the equipment to package single item kits or multi-item kits and labeling. Retail-ready cardboard reverse tuck cartons with custom-printed headers, part numbers, and barcode labels applied per your exact specifications and brand guidelines.

Single Item Kits Multi-Item Kits Custom Labeling
Clamshell  |  Plastic Containers

We do a lot of screw/nail anchor kits. These could be in clam shells, one compartment plastic containers or multi-compartment containers, labeling included. Clear clamshell and hinged plastic containers for multi-compartment hardware assortments.

Clam Shells Multi-Compartment Labeling Included
MIL-STD Packaging

We can package a variety of different small hardware items in MIL SPEC pouches and polybags to any preservation method specification including MIL-STD labeling.

Whether you have commercial kit packaging requirements or MIL-STD packaging requirements of any fastener or hardware product you can count on Nationwide Packaging Services, Inc. to exceed your expectations on speed, quality and value.
